**There is evidence of tree-cover loss in an area mapped as native forest, but it is not yet corroborated.**

In 2025, satellite data mapped approximately 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property, or 3.9% of its area. Of that, 13.1 hectares overlapped forest mapped as native in 2021.

The assessment is pending corroboration because no later year has yet been observed to confirm whether the change persists. The evidence does not establish the cause or whether deforestation or a land-use change occurred.
